title: Un-ignore the vendored Trikyn modules
intent: AzerothCore's stock .gitignore excludes /modules/*. Trikyn whitelists (un-ignores) the eleven module directories it vendors into the tree so they are tracked and build with the core, rather than being treated as external drop-ins.
reapply_notes: Low conflict risk. If JS Main rewrites the module ignore block the whitelist lines (!/modules/mod-ah-bot/ ... !/modules/mod-portable-sawmill/, plus !/modules/mod-coa-change-potions/) must be re-added. Required for every vendored-module entry below to stay tracked.

title: Vendor CoA mod-playerbots into the tree
intent: Vendors the CoA-flavored mod-playerbots (initial import at f112d520, bumped to 72fb90c5 = CoA Bots v1.4, folded Zyth v1.4->v1.5) directly into modules/ instead of consuming it as an external module. Includes an include-path adaptation for the JS Main #4780 core CoA relocation and the v1.6 login banner.
reapply_notes: Largest customization by file count (~1530 files). It is a vendored fork, not an overlay: re-vendoring from upstream mod-playerbots (origin zyth45-mpb / CoA) drops every Trikyn behavior commit below, so those must be re-folded on top. Track the vendored base revision in the commit messages.

title: Playerbots: CoA level-80 brackets and level-60 battlegrounds
intent: Adapts bot level bracketing to the realm's level-80 cap, keeps level-60 bots out of Burning Crusade/Wrath zones, routes automatic battlegrounds through level-60 brackets, and blocks under-level bots from higher-level LFG queues.
reapply_notes: Behavior overlay inside the vendored mod-playerbots; re-fold after any mod-playerbots re-vendor. trikyn-live-ops#65.

title: Playerbots: CoA combat and rotation behavior
intent: Tunes bot combat for CoA: StevenLeclerc's CastFirst attack loop (AiPlayerbot.CoaAttackLoop / CoaSpellReplacement, off by default), interrupt coordination in bot groups (AiPlayerbot.CoaInterruptCoordination, off by default), healers heal pre-emptively, tanks taunt attackers and leave alone NPCs the player would not fight, melee area attacks wait for reach, summons are not recast while up, self-heals are used, nearby-ally spells treated as ally spells, Moon Gaze/Earthmother's Binding excluded as buffs/heals, exclusive-buff pair handling, level-following spell ranks, and a cast-time multiplier overflow fix above 4.29M health.
reapply_notes: Behavior overlay inside the vendored mod-playerbots; re-fold after any re-vendor. Two features are gated behind off-by-default config keys (CoaAttackLoop, CoaSpellReplacement, CoaInterruptCoordination).

title: Playerbots: grouping, shared quests, and command parsing
intent: Grouping and quality-of-life fixes: a bot follows its player into their raid rather than an old lock, shared quests are kept (no solo run at elite quests, no abandoning quests done together), grouped bots leave BG/Dungeon Finder queues, only a whisper or item link asks a bot to trade, bot add/commands accept quoted two-word names and spaces after commas, bots drop the parachute inside instances, no resurrection through walls / meal in water / endless worldforged pickup, and test-bench bots are excluded from level-bracket rebalancing.
reapply_notes: Behavior overlay inside the vendored mod-playerbots; re-fold after any re-vendor.

title: Playerbots: dungeon teaching and capital-city life
intent: Teaches the bots to run Shadowfang Keep and Ragefire Chasm, and adds 'city life' so bots spend a while in their capitals (with matching status text).
reapply_notes: Behavior overlay inside the vendored mod-playerbots; re-fold after any re-vendor.

title: Playerbots: CoA talent and spell correctness
intent: CoA-specific correctness: bots only keep the spells of their level, CoA classes no longer learn their fallback class's quest spells, talents shared by two entries no longer swap (with the change log naming the entries), bots stop swapping talents on every refresh, and random bots stop drawing Death Knight faces.
reapply_notes: Behavior overlay inside the vendored mod-playerbots; re-fold after any re-vendor. CoA class/talent assumptions diverge from stock mod-playerbots.

title: Playerbots: stability, crash and performance fixes
intent: No crash when a bot looks over a Call Board or on an 'lfg' request without a sender, one stuck bot login no longer blocks the others, dungeon-finder bots fill missing roles and free dead queues, bots no longer walk through floors/stairs in instances, glyphs found without walking the whole item store, and immutable AI registries shared between bots.
reapply_notes: Behavior/perf overlay inside the vendored mod-playerbots; re-fold after any re-vendor. da39dc83af changes an engine registry ownership model (higher re-vendor conflict risk).

title: Playerbots: ports of upstream mod-playerbots fixes
intent: Ports of specific upstream mod-playerbots fixes onto the vendored CoA fork: whispered-item-command crash + parseMoney loop counter, null PlayerbotAI guard in HandleCommand, dead LFG packet parsing drop, bots teleported out of battlegrounds after dying, plus resolution of conflict markers left by the HandleCommand port.
reapply_notes: These are cherry-ports of upstream mod-playerbots PRs (numbers in commit subjects refer to the mod-playerbots repo, not JS Main). Re-check whether a re-vendor already contains them before re-folding to avoid double-apply.

title: Playerbots: 500 random bots by default
intent: Sets the realm default to 500 random bots. Per memory, bot count is not a lag lever on this stack; do not reduce bots as a performance fix.
reapply_notes: Config default inside the vendored mod-playerbots conf; re-apply after a re-vendor resets the conf.dist default.

title: Dynamic XP: party bots inherit the group leader's .xp rate
intent: Overlay on the JS-Main-owned mod-dynamic-xp: when a bot gains XP in a party/raid it uses the group leader's effective .xp preset instead of its own, gated behind Dynamic.XP.Preset.PlayerChoice and a new Dynamic.XP.Bots.InheritLeader (default on). Real players and solo/bot-led-group bots fall through to stock behavior.
reapply_notes: Highest-risk overlay per TRIKYN-DELTA.md: edits a JS-Main module file, so an upstream dynamicxp.cpp change or a mod-dynamic-xp re-vendor clobbers it. Re-apply from this commit. The runtime dynamicxp.conf gets the key appended by apply_trikyn_module_conf.sh on the host.

title: Vendor AuctionHouseBot (mod-ah-bot)
intent: Vendors the AuctionHouseBot module into the tree (with scoped Bugbot guidance) so the auction house is populated by a bot seller on the realm.
reapply_notes: Vendored module; survives as long as the .gitignore whitelist stays. See mod-ah-bot-profession-dump for the Trikyn data overlay on top.

title: AH bot: re-appliable profession-items dump
intent: Makes the AH bot's profession-items dump re-appliable by defining the profession-items key inline so the dump re-applies deterministically, and filters disabled/trash items. trikyn-live-ops#39.
reapply_notes: Data + config overlay on the vendored mod-ah-bot. The duplicated commit hashes are the same fix re-landed across rebases; keep the latest form.

title: Restore Path to Ascension module
intent: Restores the Path to Ascension progression module (catalog, progress, rewards loaders + world SQL) as part of a four-module restoration (#5419).
reapply_notes: Vendored module with its own data/sql/db-world migration. client_paired unknown: progression UI/rewards may reference client-side assets; confirm on the host. Shares commit #5419 with war-games, hero-call-board, item-recovery.

title: Restore War Games module
intent: Restores the War Games module (loader + world SQL + conf) as part of the #5419 restoration.
reapply_notes: Vendored module with its own data/sql/db-world migration. Shares commit #5419.

title: Restore Hero's Call Board module
intent: Restores the Hero's Call Board module (loader + world SQL + conf) as part of the #5419 restoration.
reapply_notes: Vendored module with its own data/sql/db-world migration. A playerbots stability fix exists for bots reading a Call Board (see mod-playerbots-stability-perf, commit 51d3fb933e). Shares commit #5419.

title: Restore Item Recovery module
intent: Restores the Item Recovery module (loader + conf) as part of the #5419 restoration.
reapply_notes: Vendored module. Shares commit #5419.

title: Restore Woodworking, Woodcutting and Portable Sawmill
intent: Restores the Woodworking profession, Woodcutting gathering, the Portable Sawmill item and open-world Sawmills, with world SQL for tree templates, loot tables, spawns, the sawmill gate, portable sawmill objects and a lumber-axe vendor shelf (#5550). A later fix removed a stray Dustwallow tree spawned in Mulgore (cd85c1ef5f, folded).
reapply_notes: Two vendored modules plus pending_db_world SQL. client_paired unknown: new gameobjects/trees reuse existing client models in general but the Portable Sawmill item display and any new gameobject display IDs must be confirmed against the client on the host.

title: Change Potions: include class 12 in the creation-spell catalog
intent: Adds class 12 (bit 11) to the creation-spell catalog used by the Race/Class/Faction/Customization change potions so the newest CoA class is covered by the potion flows.
client_paired_reason: Creation-spell catalog / class bitmask feeds character creation and class presentation, which is client-coupled.
reapply_notes: Overlay on mod-coa-change-potions (the module restoration itself, feat #5384 commit 295cb26068, is a folded CoA commit that also exists upstream). Keep in sync with the realm's class roster.

title: Welcome Warchest granted per character
intent: Grants the welcome warchest once per character instead of once per account, and drops warchest items that are redundant with Trikyn's level-1 grants and store. Adds a characters-DB table to track per-character grant state.
reapply_notes: Touches src/server/coa plus a pending_db_characters migration. The item list is tuned to Trikyn's level-1 grant set; revisit if those grants change.

title: Dungeon Finder pays the satchel on every completion
intent: Pays the Satchel of Helpful Goods for every Dungeon Finder completion (the stock rule only paid the random-queue reward) and grants its loot to custom CoA classes. Per memory, the satchel defect was the random-queue rule in FinishDungeon, not class masks.
reapply_notes: Core LFGMgr overlay plus a pending_db_world loot migration. trikyn-live-ops#28. High merge-conflict risk: LFGMgr is JS-Main/AzerothCore-owned and changes upstream.

title: In-game bug-report relay to Discord
intent: Adds the Trikyn in-game bug-report relay (Phase 1): the /report path hands reports to a relay (apps/coa-bugreport/trikyn_relay.py) that posts wider Discord cards. trikyn-live-ops#26.
reapply_notes: Server service header + external relay script + test. Runtime relay runs on the host. Phase 2 (feedback) is a separate entry.

title: Phase 2 in-game feedback to #trikyn-feedback
intent: Phase 2 feedback: routes in-game feedback to a #trikyn-feedback Discord channel, classifies terminal vs transient Discord errors, honors Discord Retry-After backoff (trikyn-live-ops#31), and covers the terminal-failure path with a test. trikyn-live-ops#29.
reapply_notes: Builds on coa-bug-report-relay. The Discord webhook/channel config lives on the host (UNKNOWN here).

title: Burning Swings applied to Burning Blade's attack count
intent: Applies Burning Swings to Burning Blade's attack count (Knight of Xoroth, via AscensionXorothAuras). trikyn-live-ops#32.
reapply_notes: Small CoA class-mechanic overlay; patch-id-unique to Trikyn (diverges from any upstream form). Confirm exact files with `git show 3a675f9c6f`.

title: Cap the quest menu instead of asserting
intent: When a questgiver offers more than GOSSIP_MAX_MENU_ITEMS, cap the quest menu instead of asserting (which would crash/abort). trikyn-live-ops#58. Covered by QuestMenuCapTest.
reapply_notes: Core overlay in JS-Main/AzerothCore-owned files; conflict risk on upstream gossip changes.

title: Two-word character names through quotes
intent: Reaches two-word character names (CoA allows spaces in names) through quotes in whispers and GM commands, updating the affected command handlers. Covered by PlayerNameTest. (#5676)
reapply_notes: Core overlay across several command files; patch-id-unique. High touch surface, re-check each command handler on merge.

title: New Hearthstone when binding at an inn without one
intent: Gives a new Hearthstone when a player binds at an inn and does not already have one. (#5687)
reapply_notes: Core overlay; patch-id-unique. Confirm exact hunks with `git show 6bd0ebf395`.

title: Native graveyard return, early landing, stable delete, instance resets
intent: Restores native graveyard return, early flight landing, stable character delete and instance resets (#5842). Patch-id-unique to Trikyn, so it diverges from the upstream form of #5842. Includes a coa-tests harness and a test-fixture fix for the Keeper's Scroll latecomer.
reapply_notes: Broad core movement/taxi overlay; high merge-conflict risk. Because it carries CoA PR #5842 but is patch-id-unique, compare carefully against the upstream #5842 to avoid double-apply or divergence. See memory: stale Trikyn workarounds can fight newly-folded native mechanisms.

title: Process store packets on the player thread
intent: Processes CoA store packets on the player thread instead of the map/world thread (#5544). Patch-id-unique to Trikyn. Includes an extension-packets coa-tests harness.
client_paired_reason: Touches Opcodes for CoA/Ascension extension packets, which are part of the client<->server extension protocol (Extensions.dll).
reapply_notes: Core opcode/threading overlay; high conflict risk and coupled to the Ascension extension-packet protocol. Confirm client Extensions.dll parity on the host before relying on it.

title: CoA class-mechanic batches (patch-id-divergent from upstream)
intent: A cluster of CoA class-mechanic fixes that are patch-id-unique to Trikyn (they carry CoA PR numbers but diverge in content from the upstream forms). Covers Knight of Xoroth Warbringer ranking through the War spec transform, Ranger Adaptation exclusivity + War Falcon scaling, Tinker Mechsuit/pets/Arcanoreflector, Bloodmage issue batch and Blood Covenant/Darkcasting, and class-mechanic repair batches 3 and 4.
reapply_notes: These diverge from upstream #5422/#5681/#5675/#5670/#5908/#6004/#6012 etc. On the next JS Main sync, diff each against the upstream equivalent and decide deliberately (fold vs keep Trikyn form) rather than assuming conflict-free. Several carry pending_db_world SQL. Inspect per-commit with `git show <hash>` before re-applying.

title: Unlock all quest reward appearances
intent: Unlocks all quest reward appearances for the player's collection (#6031). Patch-id-unique to Trikyn. Includes a coa-tests harness.
client_paired_reason: Appearance/transmog collection is surfaced in the client UI and can depend on client-side appearance data.
reapply_notes: Core quest/player overlay; confirm against upstream #6031 (divergent). Appearance unlocks should be validated against the client's transmog UI on the host.

title: Vendor the Windows build workflow
intent: Vendors a Windows build GitHub Actions workflow (off main) so the project can be built on Windows in CI.
reapply_notes: Standalone workflow file; low conflict risk unless upstream adds its own windows_build.yml.

title: CI compile/test pipeline tuning for trikyn-main
intent: Tunes the quality workflow for the Trikyn fork: compile + unit tests on every PR, invoke CI scripts through bash, compile with the production warning policy (not -Werror), ccache directory/caching fixes, pin the compile job to ubuntu-24.04 (the production image base), run the push workflow on trikyn-main to seed ccache, and give the compile job 180 minutes for a cold cache run.
reapply_notes: Overlay on .github/workflows/quality.yml (JS-Main-owned). Conflict-prone on any upstream CI change; re-apply the Trikyn-specific job settings. Per memory, private-repo CI needs a self-hosted runner and GitHub Pro for branch protection.

title: GitHub issue label automation
intent: Issue-labeling automation that creates missing labels before applying them, with its docstring trimmed and a test.
reapply_notes: Standalone scripts; low conflict risk.

title: Cursor Bugbot review guidance
intent: Roots Cursor Bugbot review guidance at Trikyn-touched files, with a scoped copy inside mod-ah-bot. Per memory, Bugbot stably skips test/tooling-only PRs.
reapply_notes: Documentation/config for Cursor Bugbot; low conflict risk.

title: Gameplay-test scenario exclusions for held native #5507 actions
intent: Drops gameplay-test scenarios that need held native run.py actions (the excluded #5507 'specialization' native-Extensions.dll action series) so the verification suite stays runnable on the current stack.
reapply_notes: These are deletions/exclusions on top of the folded CoA gameplay-test suite (most of apps/coa-gameplay-test is folded CoA content, not Trikyn-original). Re-evaluate once the #5507 native action series and matching client Extensions.dll land.

title: Re-bless coa-mechanics source anchors after folds
intent: Re-blesses the coa-mechanics source anchors after a JS Main advance and after the cycle-37 fold, keeping the mechanic-map anchors valid.
reapply_notes: Maintenance of the mechanic-map anchor data; re-run the blessing after each fold rather than hand-editing.

title: WorldMock::GetPlayerbotsDBRevision for test instantiation
intent: Implements WorldMock::GetPlayerbotsDBRevision so the NiceMock is instantiable once mod-playerbots adds that World interface method. trikyn-live-ops#38.
reapply_notes: Mock must track the World interface that the vendored mod-playerbots expects; re-apply if the interface changes on a re-vendor.

title: Raid difficulty: don't free live boss data on .reload config
intent: Overlay on the JS-Main-owned mod-coa-raid-difficulty: does not free live boss data on a .reload config, preventing a crash/data loss on config reload.
reapply_notes: Overlay inside a JS-Main module file; re-apply after a mod-coa-raid-difficulty re-vendor or upstream change to CoaBossAI.cpp.

title: Challenges: codestyle trim on the #5510 fold
intent: Trims codestyle whitespace left by the #5510 fold in the challenges module (the #5510 feature itself is folded CoA content).
reapply_notes: Cosmetic overlay on a JS-Main module file; low risk but drops on a re-vendor.

title: Spellbook / CoASpellbook overlay from class-mechanic batches
intent: Overlays on the JS-Main-owned mod-spellbook plus the CoASpellbook service, landed as part of class-mechanics repair batch 3 (#6004), the Bloodmage issue batch (#5908) and the #5419 module restoration. Patch-id-unique to Trikyn.
reapply_notes: These edits ride on larger commits rather than standing alone. Overlay inside a JS-Main module file (spellbook.cpp) is drop-on-re-vendor; CoASpellbook.cpp/.h are CoA server files. Confirm exact hunks with `git show 54e9101659 300319eb7d -- modules/mod-spellbook src/server/coa/CoASpellbook.cpp`.

title: Restore Battle Horn module
intent: Vendored, un-ignored module tree restoring the Battle Horn item (#5253). The originating commit reconciles with upstream (git cherry '-'), but the module tree is Trikyn-vendored and whitelisted in .gitignore, so it is catalogued at the tree level.
reapply_notes: Vendored module. Its commit is in the folded-equivalent (122) set, so it may already be present on a fresh base; confirm with `git log upstream/main..trikyn-main -- modules/mod-battlehorn` and the .gitignore whitelist. client_paired unknown: the Battle Horn item display may need client confirmation.

title: Restore Scrolls of Retreat / Defense module
intent: Vendored, un-ignored module tree restoring Scroll of Retreat: Orgrimmar/Stormwind and Scroll of Defense: Ashenvale/Hillsbrad Foothills (#5253). Catalogued at the tree level like mod-battlehorn.
reapply_notes: Vendored module; shares commit c4c495fb9c (folded-equivalent set). Confirm presence on a fresh base and the .gitignore whitelist. client_paired unknown: scroll item/teleport displays may need client confirmation.
